item.title: Research
item.description:
AI for science

Research

I develop computer vision and multimodal learning methods for scientific and healthcare applications, with an emphasis on reliability, privacy, and real-world impact.

Research areas

01

Medical AI

Computer vision and multimodal learning for radiology, chronic wound assessment, anatomical segmentation, and computer-aided diagnosis.

02

Reliable multimodal AI

Methods and evaluation protocols that improve visual grounding, factual consistency, safety, and trustworthiness in generative models.

03

Privacy-preserving vision

Imaging systems and learning methods designed to extract useful visual information while reducing the exposure of identifiable scene content.
